name: Origin Property Public Company Limited
summary: Origin Property Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, develops properties in Thailand. It develops residential condominium units; and sells land and house. The company also provides interior decoration, property management, and real estate sales agency and related services; and invests in other companies. In addition, it engages in the food and beverage business. The company was founded in 2009 and is based in Mueang Samut Prakan, Thailand.
